en.does_not_prove: Many legitimate servers do not sign, and a missing signature is common; it proves nothing about authenticity either way.
en.shows: The message carries no DKIM-Signature header.
en.title: No DKIM signature

en.does_not_prove: Server clocks are sometimes wrong and some servers add Received headers out of order; it does not show that a header was inserted or edited.
en.shows: Hop 2 was stamped 2026-11-11T09:40:00Z, 1200 s before the previous hop 1 (2026-11-11T10:00:00Z), beyond the tolerated clock difference (1 such step(s)).
en.title: Received times go backwards

en.does_not_prove: The sender's clock may be wrong; it does not show that the date was changed after sending.
en.shows: The Date header (2026-11-11T11:30:00Z) is 5400 s later than the time the first server received the message (2026-11-11T10:00:00Z).
en.title: Date header later than the first server

en.does_not_prove: Clients and servers are often set to different zones, travellers keep their home zone; it does not show that the date was edited.
en.shows: The Date header uses zone +0500 while the sender organisation's first server used +0000 (sender_server_zone_differs).
en.title: Time zone inconsistent

en.does_not_prove: Mail clients, sending services and webmail hosts generate Message-IDs with their own names; it does not show that the message is forged.
en.shows: The Message-ID was generated under mailer.example.com, not under the From domain example.org.
en.title: Message-ID from another domain
